'''Wojciech Wisniewski Empire Strikes back''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Wojciech Wisniewski]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-18245">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/18245 Empire Strikes back], DeckTech (Wojciech "Hipo" Wisniewski, 11 August 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/18245/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/18245/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Wojciech Wisniewski]]
* '''Published:''' 11 August 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Empire Strikes back''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Desert Landing Site|Tat-D-tatooinedesertlandingsite.gif}}

* '''Strategy:''' Lately I'm little bored playing the same tournament decks all the time, so I prefer playing fun decks at the moment and this is next of them.

== Original post ==

'''Empire Strikes back'''
* '''Author:''' Wojciech "Hipo" Wisniewski
* '''Published:''' August 11, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' Lately I'm little bored playing the same tournament decks all the time, so I prefer playing fun decks at the moment and this is next of them.

=== Strategy ===

The strategy is very simple, just get your locations out of your deck and  than start draining your opponent with sabers and Gailid. You should have enought power to win on the ground and in space... Well if you're lucky you might win the game agains space deck.

I won't write more about strategy becouse like I said this deck is supposed to be fun deck, and winning isn't the most important. So have fun and thanks for reading.
